opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in a mining pool, stating that the pool costs $4,100 and describing a daily payout. It presents a $4,000 investment as producing $15,000 in profit, while recommending the mining plan over buying Bitcoin. Viewers are directed to use the Cryptolag29 link to register and “start making money today,” tying sign-up and payment-oriented participation directly to the promised returns. The page reinforces that solicitation with mining offers, displayed prices, purchase buttons, share-sale prompts, BTC amounts, payout figures, and reinvestment controls. These facts establish promotional paid mining and node-return claims, although the projected figures are not shown to be guaranteed, realized, withdrawable, or independently verified.
